title: Canonical arrow lists for finite mapping adjunction
statement: For the finite-field datum, finite coefficient extension, finite-Tor constructible classes, compactification, derived Hom and coefficient duality of the cited statement dependencies, retain the actual published global Hom and compact-support sections functors and all their canonical comparison arrows. Define FiniteMappingComposite as endpoint-sensitive composition of a list of Arrow objects, and FiniteMappingSameComposite as equality of two such composites. Define functorial arrow transport, global comparison via the comparison derived unit and Leray, etale point duality, both mapping functors, etale comparison lists, dual transport lists, tensor comparison lists, the scalar-unit list, the exceptional counit input and list, Hom-first transpose and the projection/evaluation/exceptional-counit pairing. Each is exactly the corresponding existing construction previously in the finite mapping adjunction module. There is no mathematical alteration and no existence choice.
